method: Live Simulator via CUA. Inspected screenshots and accessibility trees of each listed question and submitted the stated answer. Development review uses production QuestionView with canonical choices and suppresses history writes.

items.parking_disc_actual_arrival: P symbol, arrival label and dial visible; B actual arrival scores correctly.
items.parking_camera_requires_direct_checks: Camera image and bay clear; A direct/mirror checks scores correctly.
items.priority_officer_over_green_light: Officer faces viewer, both arms clearly horizontal. D front and rear approaches scores correctly.
items.motorway_wrongway_alert_no_overtake: Amber warning text readable, coherent carriageway; A no overtaking scores correctly.
items.motorway_planned_break_two_hours: Rest area scene fits; B planned pause scores correctly.
items.speed_reaction_one_second_90: Road scene visible, assumptions explicit; C 25 metres scores correctly.
items.speed_double_braking_distance_quadruples: Closed driving area scene fits; D quadrupled distance scores correctly.
items.overtake_signal_before_moving_left: Following before moving out; C signal before manoeuvre scores correctly.
items.alcohol_carrying_breathalyser_optional: Breathalyser and equipment visible; A optional scores correctly.
items.safety_oil_pressure_stop_engine: Red oil symbol and STOP readable; B safe stop then engine off scores correctly.

multiple_answer_checks.fr_partial_selection: B alone: Incorrect, B and C shown as correct; multiple-answer instruction visible.
multiple_answer_checks.en_complete_selection: B and C: Correct, multiple-answer instruction visible.

limitations: Existing semantic-review queue remains open for final bank uniqueness; visual approval does not guarantee undetectable errors.
